add.name: writing-shape
add.purpose: Turns a raw-material markdown file (notes, fragments, transcript) into an article paragraph by paragraph: settles reader prerequisites, offers 2-3 openings, then grows and appends each block with deliberate format choices.
add.how_to_use: Manual invoke only (disable-model-invocation); pass a markdown file of raw material and an output path.
add.evidence: skills.sh ~406k installs and on the trending list (Sept/Oct 2026); 274k-star repo
add.notes: Lives in the repo's 'in-progress' folder, so paths may move. Sibling 'writing-beats' (same folder) is a choose-your-own-adventure variant of the same exploit step.

add.name: writing-fragments
add.purpose: Explore phase of Matt Pocock's writing pipeline: interviews the author relentlessly and appends usable fragments to one markdown file, without imposing structure.
add.how_to_use: Manual invoke; run before writing-shape / writing-beats. Asks once where to save the fragments file.

add.name: writing-dna-skill
add.purpose: Distils a reusable 'Writing DNA' (language, structure, topic selection, evidence strategy, framing, visual style) from 20+ complete articles by an author or brand, then writes new pieces in that DNA.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on style-analysis / write-like-X requests; needs at least 20 full source articles. Bilingual (Chinese/English).
add.evidence: 2.25k stars since late June 2026; on skills.sh /hot list
add.notes: Frontmatter description is mostly Chinese; English README provided.
